byterover_query.answer:
BYTEROVER-QUERY-LONG
The complete ByteRover answer includes a long architectural explanation of the catalog injection seam, object-tree harness, query-only operation fixtures, zero-network preview guarantee, explicit normal and long-content collection minimums, and representative assertion markers for every key operation.
